title: Table per Type (TPT)
description: Learn TPT strategy with base and derived tables linked by shared keys.

data.text: **Table per Type (TPT)** maps each type in the inheritance hierarchy to its own database table. The base table stores shared properties, and each derived table stores type-specific properties.

items: Multiple related tables (base + one per derived type)
Derived tables reference base table (shared key)

data.caption: TPT multiple table structure
data.definition:
graph TD
    A[Animal Table] -->|shared key| B[Cat Table]
    A -->|shared key| C[Dog Table]

items: You prefer clear separation between base and derived data
You don't mind JOINs for schema clarity
Many polymorphic queries across derived types

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about TPC strategy.
